name: Kasannoin Kyoumi
source:
[url=/c1102]Kyouichi's[/url] younger sister, she is an extreme brocon. She is jealous of his girlfriend, [url=/c1601]Nanami[/url] and the number of women her brother's dated to the point she never tries to hide her affection for him.
